notes.title: 'Deep Pockets' Update Preview
notes.content:
'Deep Pockets' Update
Some people in Blomkest have deep pockets...and others deep secrets. Discover new ways to spend your hard-earned shills once the main story is finished, embark on a new questline, and uncover who's been pulling threads behind the scenes...

This update will give you some new things to do once you've reached the ending, so read on to learn what's in store (no pun intended), and how you can try it out today!


Dig a Basement
You need more space and can't expand outward...so what about straight down? This update adds a new questline that sees you expanding Discounty once again. But as you've no doubt learned, nothing in Blomkest comes easy...and there might be some other people in town who take an unexpected interest in your new basement project.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/c5ff82199466d691c0d3f0fa12e0726000a65fef.png"]Nothing to see here.


Level Up Your Shop!
Don't let your Discounty Rewards Points go to waste! We're adding a few new items to the Rewards Shop, including a new post-game category with some cool new ways to boost your efficiency and profits!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/4d715e72a9fe738277fd4c96ff83934fdf2a495c.png"]

A New Coat of Paint
Solruna has been experimenting with extracting the essences of color, and believes a new coat of colored paint might be just the thing to purge the negative energies Discounty brought to town. In a new quest, you will learn how to transmute items from your store into new colors for the shop exterior. For a price, of course.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/3ba64a5e8667d94c6933641aae31d98fdde3b8c5.gif"]

Quality of Life & Bug Fixes
We're also throwing in a bunch of quality of life improvements and bug fixes! Some highlights include the ability to swap back to the cash register after upgrading the scanner, improvements to Chester's behavior, clarifying certain quests, and much more!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/a190112519a246a6b4b429d45f4abcd018a1df90.png"]

Try the Public Beta!
Sound exciting? Well, good news: you can try it out right now! We've added a new Steam branch that will allow you to test updates so you can let us know what you think before it goes out to everyone!

We highly recommend backing up your saves before playing the public beta branch! To do so, back up the files in the following folder: %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Crinkle Cut Games/Discounty.

  To access the branch: 

 Go to your Steam library and find Discounty


 Right click the game and click "Properties"


 In the Properties window, go to the Beta tab, and select the "publicbeta" branch from the drop-down menu.


For now, the beta is only available in English. However, we will be adding all the other languages soon. To get notified of updates, watch our news page for patch notes, or join our Discord  and choose the Public Beta role for pings! This Discord is also the best place to give feedback about the beta.

And remember to back up your saves!


Also: We Have a Wiki!
Need help giving gifts to rats, infusing apples, or figuring out the most profitable items?

Learn more — or help write a guide — in our brand new Wiki, hosted by wiki.gg! We've been working on this with a few community members over the last few days. Since we expect Discounty  will continue to grow for a long time, we want to build this up and make it the ultimate resource for all things Discounty.

But we need YOUR help: check out the Official Discounty Wiki now!


Patch Notes: Version 1.1.0 Beta

🛒 = this change was suggested by players! 


Quests
Discounty Basement: Adds a multi-part questline, starting in Chapter 2 and continuing into the endgame, in which the player can add a basement to their store.


The Boiling Brew: Adds a quest that introduces you Solruna's new experiments with paint. Can be started after seeing Solruna's final friendship event.


 🛒 Corporate Espionage: the stealth route is shorter, and now spawns automatically when player is in the forest between 19:00 and 20:00.


 🛒 Beyond the Fog: reduced the firewood Elmer requires to 1 piece, and clarified quest text.


 🛒 An Apple of the Occult: changed wording of objective to reduce player confusion.


 🛒 The Fishy Fisherman: players can now speak with Barbara to get more Fishmas Sticks if needed.

Shop:
 Basement: players can unlock a basement, giving extra storage space for item boxes, shelves, and decorations.


 🛒 Scanner can now be toggled back to cash register using the PC.


 🛒 Chester won't steal: fixed bug that could cause items Chester holds to be lost when the player leaves the store.


 Chester can now place items back in boxes if all shelves are full and he's got nothing better to do.


 🛒 Improved scanner tutorial to clarify the controls.


 🛒 Customers now queue based on proximity to the cash register, rather than the order in which they finish their shopping lists. No more cutting in line!


 🛒 Trash compactor lights now indicate what type of waste they contain.


 Added a red-tinted "0" to empty shelves.


 🛒 Players can no longer place items behind fridges. Already-placed items can be picked up.

New Rewards Shop Items
 Improved Sponge: can be used 3 times before wetting again.


 Ultimate Sponge: can be used 4 times before wetting again.


 Discounty Bucket: bucket no longer has an appeal penalty


 Advanced Employee Shoes: Chester moves faster.


 Premium Employee Shoes: Chester moves even faster


 Employee Gloves: Chester restocks faster.


 Premium Employee Gloves: Chester restocks even faster.


 Category Discounts: get a discount when purchasing items in a particular category. Each category discount has 4 tiers.

Dialogues
 Guy will no longer introduce himself in Chapter 2 and beyond.


 🛒 Derek can no longer talk about his workday before getting to work.


 Karl no longer mentions the tea shop destruction early.


 Ted and Solruna will now kick you out of their shops if you stay too late.

Visuals
 Added opening hours signs to all shops and trade deal vendors.


 Improved look of the green sea.


 Multiple aquariums no longer have synchronized movement.


 Added particle effect when the PC is unpacked

User Interface
 🛒 Character customization options are now numbered.


 Added "Scan" command & button when using the scanner


 Added progress bar to the Rewards Shop showing how many new items have been unlocked.

Other
 Reduced the number of colliders and volumetric lighting sources in town to increase performance.


 Players can no longer immediately go to bed; can only sleep at 9:30 or later on all days.


 Ted's opening hours are now properly set to the times listed.


 Solruna now closes her shop at 20:00, to leave to parts unknown...


 Post-credits popup has now been changed to Player dialogue.

Bug Fixes
 🛒 Fixed customers getting stuck when doors to the warehouse are blocked.


 🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in hay bales near farm.


 🛒 Fixed players getting stuck next to Fisher's mailbows.


 Fixed Ms. Andersen looking out her window when she's outside in some instances.


 Fixed Elmer's fireplace not being lit when it should be.


 Fixed unaligned walls in shop.


 Removed extra pixels in James' sprite.


 Fixed game pausing time after opening & closing sewer menus.


 Fixed gap in visual boundary around shop.


 🛒 Chester's third friendship event is no longer available during Blomkest Fair, which could cause a soft lock.


 🛒 Small potted tree now only spawns in the back slot at Solruna's store.


 🛒 Fixed bird bath not returning to normal after finishing the related quest.


 🛒 Advanced trade deal items can no longer be selected before they're unlocked.


 Fixed bucket spawning too early.


 🛒 Expand and Conquer quest: Elmer's documents can no longer spawn in a way that can trap players.


 🛒 Fixed rat bowl spawning too soon.


We hope you're excited for the update! :)

xoxo
Crinkle Cut Games

notes.title: Discounty Patch 2 - Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Attention, shoppers! 

Discounty's second major patch is here! We've been able to include some of our community's most-requested features and squash many of the remaining critical bugs, including:

 A faster and skippable end-of-day report.
 Players getting stuck in numerous locations.
 Time skipping ahead too far in the post-game.
 ...and Elmer is less of a creep.

Check out the full patch notes below. (This Patch, along with all previous patches, is now being ported to consoles as well!) Thanks again to everyone who's been providing feedback: since we are just a four-person studio, your reports have been immensely helpful to us and we are so grateful!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/c81c7dc4bbe422c4da42fdf7fb101a6c2c3dc437.gif

What's Next?
We're already working on our next major update, which will include more polish, bug fixes, and highly-requested quality-of-life features -- like the ability to switch back to the standard cash register after unlocking the scanner. But more excitingly: the next update will also include new content to expand the endgame and give you more reasons to continue playing! While we can't promise any specifics right now, we hope to drop this update about a month from now, so keep an eye out for more info soon!

If you haven't yet, could you please take a moment to review the game on Steam? A good rating helps us support the game for as long as possible! 🙏

🛒 = this change was suggested by players! 
(You'll notice that almost every item has a 🛒 next to it -- huge shout-out to everyone in our community who's been reporting bugs & helping us diagnose them!)

Shop:

🛒 End of day report runs faster the more items it displays.

Cutscenes:

 Increased the time window in which it's possible to start the [spoiler]pipe cutscene.[/spoiler]

Getting Stuck:

🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in crab pots at the harbor.
🛒 Fixed players getting stuck behind Tellar's house.
🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in the lamp post at the top of the harbor stairs.
🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in the [spoiler]flock of sheep at the Blomkest Fair.[/spoiler]
🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in mailboxes.
🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in Elmer's hedge.
🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in the rocks outside the mine.
🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in trees in multiple locations in the forest.
🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in farm fields.
🛒 Fixed players getting stuck in crates near Fisher's boat.

Dialogues, schedules & quests:

🛒 Fixed Elmer relentlessly hitting on the player. (This dialogue now only plays once as intended.)
🛒 Fixed two friendship events spawning at the same time leading to a soft lock.
🛒 Fixed various issues with the Corporate Espionage quest that could soft lock players who started the quest on a Sunday.
🛒 Fixed soft-locking the game if you clicked on [spoiler]Fluffles[/spoiler] first when painting sheep in the Karl's second trade deal quest.
🛒 Fixed issue with players needing to start “Operating as a Real Supermarket” by going to the farm, rather than being able to start any of the trade deal vendor quests.
🛒 Fixed issue with players being soft-locked during Tammy's third trade deal quest.
🛒 Fixed players being soft-locked due to the clock reaching midnight during a scene transition in Tammy's first trade deal quest.

🛒 Tammy's menu
🛒 Graces first friendship event

🛒 Ted's first friendship event

notes.title: 💌 Discounty News - July 2025 (+ Price Announcement!)
notes.content:
Hello shoppers!

Things are really exciting here at Crinkle Cut, because Discounty is FINALLY launching in less than one month.

Well, let's get into it before I start screaming. 😱 This is a condensed version of our July email newsletter. Make sure to subscribe to our newsletter for the full version — new subscribers get the latest issue in their inbox! Here are the highlights:

💸 Price Announcement
A lot of you have been waiting on this news. We can finally give you an anwser:

Discounty will cost $19.99 USD on Steam (or your equivalent local price!).
 
But it wouldn't be Discounty without a discount! There be a 20% launch discount on Steam for two weeks. That means you can get Discounty for under 16 bucks! Wow!

We're offering a big discount in the hope that lots of people can finally play our game right away. We know some of you have been waiting over two years for this game to come out. notes.title: 💌 Discounty News - May 2025
notes.content:
Attention shoppers!

First of all, to everyone eagerly awaiting more news about Discounty's launch, all I have to say is: stay tuned! 👀

In the meantime, we wanted to share a few development updates pulled from our most recent email newsletter. Make sure to subscribe to our newsletter for the full version — new subscribers get the latest issue in their inbox!

🎉 A MAZE. Festival: Making a playable demo!
As we wrote in our last newsletter update, Discounty was nominated for an A MAZE. Award at the A MAZE. Festival in Berlin this year. That also included the opportunity to showcase the game at the Exhibition, along with all the other nominated games.

Because of that, we had to make a demo version of the game! We wanted to show off some of the best parts of the early game in a short demo that could be completed in a half hour. We threw one together then got it all set up at the festival. We met so many cool people, and that alone was worth the trip!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/2124837f9abac5e258b45d492c9e2f79426e9fb4.png
🌐 LOCALIZATION: Discounty goes global!
We want as many people as possible to play Discounty, which means we need to localize the game! That means translating every bit of text — from dialogue to quest logs to UI — into a bunch of different languages.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/46affbcd808edb3e4f243f80d9e392d813095853.png
If that sounds like a lot of work...it is! Thankfully, our publisher is working with localizers to bring the game into all of our target languages. (By the way, these are English, French, German, Spanish (Spain), Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Simplified & Traditional Chinese, and Danish.)

But getting the text translated isn't the end of it. After we got the translations back, we've had to make sure they're re-implemented into the game properly. Translations can unexpectedly break code, longer words can extend outside of text boxes, and there are sometimes lines that might not get implemented properly since we have a massive & confusing text database. But it will definitely be worth it when fans all over the world can play the game in their native language!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/454a42918f775c511c221b0e56a16888d4e19dc8.png
💬 Mods? ...Mods??
As a reward for reading to the last entry, we're going to let you in on a little secret…we’re going to open a Discord server for Discounty very soon! The Discord is going to be a crucial place for us as developers to gather feedback to improve the game. If you want to be a part of making Discounty into the best possible game it can be, keep your eyes peeled here and on our social media channels for more info in the coming days!

That's it for this month's dev update! If you want to read more, make sure to sign up for the newsletter here. Thanks for reading, and see you next month!

xoxo
Crinkle Cut Games

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/f812fa40bd40df8a0fdc422a625710f89791f461.gif

notes.title: 💌 Discounty News - April 2025
notes.content:
Attention shoppers!

We recently sent out our April newsletter! A LOT has been happening in the last few months, so we're excited to finally spill the tea a bit. So here's an excerpt from our last email about what we've been up to! Make sure to subscribe to our newsletter for the full version — new subscribers get the latest issue in their inbox!

🎉 TAGS Event in Copenhagen
We recently showed our game to the public for the first time EVER! In February we had the opportunity to show Discounty as part of Copenhagen Gaming Week. Our core team is located in Denmark, but we were able to bring in our publishing team and social/comms manager Ian, and it was actually the first time we all got to meet together in person! It was really special to chat with each other while watching random people trying Discounty, while also getting useful feedback to improve the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/643ac4fe929b15efc9412936acb7d5a0a036c3e7.png
🧪 PLAYTESTING: Getting your feedback 
We've also had our first closed playtests since our last newsletter! We invited a small number of testers to play the first two hours of Discounty. As they played, they provided ongoing commentary and reactions to everything they experienced. We are currently preparing for a much larger-scale playtest in the next couple months, so stay tuned if you've signed up already, or join our newsletter to get the signup link!

🪞 CHARACTER CREATOR: Be who you want
Our much-anticipated character creation system is now fully implemented! There are 6 categories you can adjust to change your character's appearance, each with a wide range of color options. Behold:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/cf6ce1bf980f8a8f6787625e0ade556b09a30a7e.gif
🎵 Meet the Team: James (Music)
About Me: I’m a working musician in London but for the last 5 years I’ve been composing music and doing audio for games! It was an easy bridge of two of my passions! Bringing worlds to life and bouncing ideas off a dev team has been an absolute joy. Especially inside the indie game scene where such amazing art and game design really helps fuel the music I can make. I love working with soundfonts and working around their limitations but also any excuse to make something grandiose is never out of the question!

🏆 Some A MAZE.-ing News
Discounty has been nominated for an A MAZE. Award! We are honored to be nominated for the WINGS Award, presented by WINGS Fund, which recognizes games made by teams with women & gender-marginalized developers in key positions, like us!

As part of the nomination, we'll be able to exhibit a demo of Discounty throughout the event from May 14-17 in Berlin. So if you happen to live in the area and want to give Discounty a try, please come by. (And congrats to our fellow nominees! So many cool games!!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/34c047dbe2a1a670d1e1d7c4ac9981fc824a659e.jpg
👋 Until Next Time
That's it for now, but since we're getting ever closer to the game's release later this year, we're going to start sending out these newsletters every month. Subscribers get these updates first, and with twice as much content, so make sure to sign up here! Thanks for reading, and see you next month!

xoxo

notes.title: 🛍️ Discounty Devlog: What We've Been Working On Lately
notes.content:
Hello shoppers,

It's been a while since we last updated you here about what we've been working on, so we wanted to give you a quick little peek behind the scenes! But first: we'd like to give a special thanks to all the mystery shoppers who participated in our recent Closed Playtesting for Discounty. We'll be doing another, larger round of playtesting soon, so if you missed out on the last round, make sure to sign up for our newsletter for more details.

What We've Been Up To
In the last few months we've been working hard to finalize all of the systems in the game. That means doing a lot of the "boring" things that nevertheless have to get done. For example, we finally added multiple save slots into the game, which is of course very important, but maybe not so interesting to talk about:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/0f014998569a65c865f9efab7d0da01efc17edd4.png
On the more exciting side, we've also been expanding our rotating cast of shoppers who come into Discounty. You've got a lot of customers to serve, and not all of them are locals. Blomkest is conveniently located on the highway, and your bright billboard lures in many commuters every day. To make sure your store feels full and varied, we needed to have lots of unique NPCs who could stop in to shop. For a while, many of these customers have been creepy clones of each other — but no more! Here's a sneak peek of some of the new NPCs:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/057a94606979bde2f151d0751d5dda82530d40e1.png
We've also put the finishing touches on our Challenges system. These are daily and weekly goals you can complete in your store, like selling X cartons of milk in a day, or ordering a certain number of boxes of fish. This encourages players to continually optimize their stores to earn reward points to unlock more wares, expand their inventories, and more:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/958ffdbde307d1e0d86bd9dc0b1039a7fd5a319b.png

🧾 What’s Next?
Behind the scenes, we’ve been working on the next newsletter, some new game refinements, and a few things we can’t quite talk about just yet. But we promise: there’s plenty more in store for Discounty, and you're going to start hearing from us a lot more frequently in the coming months.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/0cb24dd7332a822c39ab148489642e61ef506b27.gif

Keep an eye on this space for updates, announcements, and more chances to step into the world we’re creating. And please: let us know what you'd like to see from us! Until then, thank you for being part of the journey!

xoxo
Crinkle Cut Games

notes.title: PQube Announces Partnership With Crinkle Cut Games To Publish Discounty!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

PQube is excited to reveal our partnership with Crinkle Cut Games, and introduce gamers worldwide to the wholesome store management sim 'Discounty'!

Nothing in life is handed to you... 
Except, this new job as a shopkeeper... 
And eventually the entire store... 

*Ahem*. 

Step into the shoes of an aspiring supermarket manager as you navigate the intricacies of salvaging your local store and growing it into a business empire!

Organise your shop, manage your stock levels, work the checkout, and barter for trade goods within the community - all the while meeting your customer's specific needs. Build relationships or make enemies by interacting with the local townsfolk and forging a new life of your own in Blomkest.

Check out Discounty's TikTok page to learn more about the game!

[previewyoutube=KnyBjeQO5_k;full][/previewyoutube]

A Warm-ish Welcome to Blomkest 
(please ignore the rats)
Following a call from your not-so-distant Aunt Tellar, you find yourself in Blomkest, a once-thriving run-down harbor town with a dwindling population. Your job? To help her revive the local Discounty branch as the shopkeeper and grow it into a business empire!

Aunt Tellar may have forgotten to mention that you'll be living in an old garage...but you'll get used to it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/6dd6d3c4603d1cc65333bdbf22ba54e2e392f6e4.png

Craft Your Shopkeeper
Personalise your appearance, handpick your outfit, and give yourself a name that resonates with your unique style. Rest assured, your ever-wise Aunt will always know you, no matter your chosen guise.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/bcab51119bf38bf467ec71f0dbda24a7f07e846e.png

Build & Expand Your Dream Shop
As shopkeeper, it is your duty to rearrange shelves and products to create the most inviting and efficient shop layout. Each customer has personality traits that govern their behaviours as they wander around your store. Use this information to help thoughtfully design your aisles and guide an array of shoppers to their unique wants and needs.
 
Add delightful decorations to try and encourage an extra sale or two! Reinvest your profits to expand and make your shop bigger! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/0cb24dd7332a822c39ab148489642e61ef506b27.gif

The Customer Is Always Right 
Balance the many chaotic tasks of a shopkeeper... ensure shelves are stocked, floors gleam and the storage room exudes perfect order and tidiness! Each visitor arrives with their own shopping list and distinct preferences (not everyone is the easiest to deal with...). 

It's your heartfelt duty to ensure every shopper leaves with a smile!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/6dfe3c16924d181b23233bdf1c685e59390514c2.png

Ring Up Customer's Shopping Swiftly
Your customers don't have all day... quickly scan through shopping lists and successfully calculate total bills. Your efficiency will make customers happy, encouraging their loyalty. Can you navigate the bustling store to meet everyone's needs with grace and goodwill?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/9d256a8050e89d0e7a342e9252c4fbee4ff56c94.png

Strike Trade Deals With Locals
Blomkestians don't take particularly well to newcomers, but there are still quite a few producers and manufacturers left in town. Gain their trust, make trade deals, and sell local goods to make more profit!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/2a7754c71c8527b8b32b0989b04ce67cfe16f6af.png

Build Heartfelt Relationships (or make lifelong enemies)
Beyond the store's regular hours, you're invited to discover the town's delightful quirks and befriend its charming residents. Building relationships with each soul in this town isn't just about business; it's an opportunity to uncover the enchanting mysteries of Blomkest's past. Although, not all of your fellow villagers want you to succeed. 

Turns out, not everyone loves ever-expanding, never-enough, cold-hearted, money-crazed capitalism. He-he. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/d0b7864a4a83ddfae7c6dbe670e8c85e513f54d3.png

notes.title: Welcome to Discounty
notes.content:
